versions.content: For inter-ECU communication with incoherent implicit dataWriteAccess no write-back copy actions to a global RTE-buffer will be per- formed, if the involved runnables are all running in one preemption area. In this case the DataWriteCompletedEvent shall be fired after the termination of the last send- ing runnable in the sending task/ISR2 and after the transmission acknowledgment from COM or LdCom is complete, i.e. the acknowledgment has been received and in case of RTE-fanout all acknowledgments have been received. The transmission status shall be RTE_E_TRANSMIT_ACK and can be collected with Rte_IFeedback API.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00122 For inter-ECU communication with incoherent implicit dataWriteAccess no write- back copy actions to a global RTE-buffer will be performed, if the involved runnables are all running in one preemption area. In this case the DataWriteCompletedEvent shall be fired after the termination of the last sending runnable in the sending task/ISR2 and after the transmission of all related COM Signal(Group)s and COM Large Data IPdus is complete. The transmission status (success or type of error) can be collected with the Rte_IFeedback API.
